parsed.answer: Requests for a standalone Command Palette have been filed before. The team has said (PowerToys#38684) that they plan to release it as a standalone app at some point; Command Palette is already a separate MSIX package inside PowerToys, so it was deliberately kept loosely tied to PowerToys settings and tray icon, and when it is split out the packages should share the same identity so that migration is seamless. PowerToys#42103 is a duplicate of that request and points to #38684, and a graduation discussion (#41852) was merged into it. Please follow #38684 for updates and add your scenario (non-admin users, locked-down machines) there. A generic portable/zip install of PowerToys (PowerToys#598) was declined by the team because they would have to support and test it every release, so don't expect an official zip. Your own repo's zip is an unofficial workaround: it isn't a supported distribution and users should only install it if they trust the source.
